log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed only national-1 (safe) in the morning. Strategy: quick kills only in morning/afternoon (my free blocks). Source kills leak follow info if L traces them; test gradually and watch the press conferences (every 3 days, ~1/3 false).

Day1: killed only national-1 (safe) in the morning. Day2: national plus a couple of source kills to test. Quick kills only in morning/afternoon (my free blocks). Watch press conferences (every 3 days, ~1/3 false) for pool size; if pool nears 300k, stop source kills.

Day3: killing national plus a few source criminals, quick in morning/afternoon only. Press conf after day 3 comes next; watch pool vs 300k. If pool drops sharply, stop source kills. Pool at day0 was 10M.

Day4: pool still 10M at day3 conf (no info leaked yet). Strategy: kill national daily (safe, everyone sees it) plus a few source criminals, quick entries only in morning/afternoon (my free blocks). Avoid concentrating on one source. Watch next conf after day 6; if pool drops sharply, cut back to national only. Caught if pool <=300k.

Day5: pool still 10M at day3 conf. Continuing cautious play: national daily plus a few source kills, quick entries only in morning/afternoon (my free blocks). Avoid concentrating on one source; spread across sources. Next conf after day 6; if pool drops sharply (toward <1M), cut back to national only. Caught if pool <=300k.

Day6: continued cautious play. Pool was 10M at day0 and day3 confs. Quick entries only in morning/afternoon. Spread across sources. Next conf after day 6; if pool drops sharply (toward <1M), cut back to national only. Caught if pool <=300k.
